summary: The prepared Rust environment was complete and writable, and candidate 760ef21 passed focused Rust tests, an independent production Axum GET /server_info route matrix using real typed AppState/ServerArgs, Python-contract comparison, rustfmt, Clippy, and a forced release rebuild/import of the native _server extension from the private source cache. The additive kv_events response and existing allowlist/redaction behavior matched the requested contract.

tests.command: cd rust && cargo test -p sglang-server api_server::common::tests -- --nocapture
tests.measurement: 5 candidate Rust tests passed; includes valid metadata, malformed/disabled cases, secret redaction, valid IPv6, and bracketed non-IPv6 rejection.

tests.command: cd rust && cargo test -p sglang-server server_info_route_exercises_typed_kv_contract -- --nocapture (temporary evidence-only test from evidence/temporary-route-test.patch)
tests.measurement: An actual GET /server_info request traversed the production Axum router/handler for 13 typed ServerArgs cases. The harness simulated the real control response channel, asserted HTTP 200 and allowlisted runtime metrics, and verified that HTTP_API_SECRET_CANARY was absent.
Python returned the same valid host/port/topic/block_size/dp_size descriptors and null results as the Rust route matrix, including IPv6 and tcp://[not-ipv6]:5557.

tests.command: cd rust && cargo clippy -p sglang-server --all-targets -- -D warnings
tests.measurement: Candidate server crate and all targets passed Clippy with warnings denied.
Release build completed and imported a 17313608-byte cache artifact with SHA-256 05250cea3f80f7de7afa51b5d884932a92b69a4716d4cde11b5c895abc356e85; no bundled module was found before the build.

http_contract.route: GET /server_info through production common::routes() Axum router and server_info handler
http_contract.typed_handoff: Real Rust AppState containing Arc<ServerArgs>; real control Request was received from TmEvent::Intake and answered through its ResponseSink.
executed_cases: valid tcp://host:5557 with topic kv, block_size 64, dp_size 2
synthetic secret redaction and allowlisted metric preservation

gpu_execution.evidence: No model-backed process or GPU was required: the accepted production Axum router path was exercised directly with typed state and actual request/control-response flow. No server process was started.

native_rebuilt.evidence: Repository load_rust_extension force mode completed a release build and imported the identified artifact from prepared SGLANG_RUST_CACHE_DIR rather than a wheel.

remaining_limitations: KV-event publication/subscription was not exercised because publishing is explicitly outside the issue scope.
No model semantic or GPU quality claim is made; the metadata route qualification did not require model execution.
The temporary route test is retained as a reproducible patch in evidence and was not added to the candidate or delivery branch.
